_comment: Device Setup card of the BH SPC backend (acquisition window, Device Setup...), drawn by emtk over setup_forms.BHSetupForm. Bounds and options are BH_PARAMETERS of setup_models.py (test_setup_specs.py keeps the two equal). Replaces the hand-drawn card and, before it, the Qt BHSPCCardSetupDialog.
